recipes.name: Prawn saganaki

steps.name: Crush the garlic
steps.text: Crush the garlic.

steps.name: Fry the garlic
steps.text: Heat the oil and fry the garlic for 1 minute.

steps.name: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Add the tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 4 minutes.

steps.name: Cook the prawns
steps.text: Add the prawns and cook for 4 minutes, until pink right through. Microwave one rice pouch at the same time.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: Take the pan off the heat. Crumble over the feta and squeeze over half the lemon.

steps.name: Portion and plate
steps.text: Set half aside for tomorrow and plate up. Pierre-Guy: 375g saganaki and 150g rice. Mariska: 250g saganaki and 100g rice.

recipes.storage: Cool within 1 hour and refrigerate. Reheat gently in a pan for 3 to 4 min until piping hot, and microwave the second rice pouch fresh.

recipes.name: Lentil and mushroom ragù with Parmesan and walnuts
ingredients: Black pepper and a pinch of salt

steps.name: Prep the veg
steps.text: Mince the garlic, then thickly slice the mushrooms.

steps.name: Fry the mushrooms
steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the oil for 5 minutes. Drain and rinse the lentils while they cook.

steps.name: Add garlic and purée
steps.text: Add the garlic and tomato purée and stir for 1 minute.

steps.name: Simmer
steps.text: Add the lentils, tomatoes, oregano and a splash of water and simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.name: Season and plate
steps.text: Season, then plate with grated Parmesan and the walnuts broken over by hand. Pierre-Guy: 495g ragù, 15g Parmesan, 12g walnuts. Mariska: 330g ragù, 10g Parmesan, 8g walnuts.

recipes.storage: Cool within 1 hour and refrigerate. Reheat with a splash of water until piping hot, then add fresh Parmesan and walnuts.

recipes.name: Chickpea fatteh with wilted spinach

steps.name: Drain the chickpeas
steps.text: Drain and rinse the chickpeas.

steps.name: Warm the chickpeas
steps.text: Warm the chickpeas with the cumin, 1 tbsp oil and a splash of water for 5 minutes, lightly crushing a few. While they warm, wash the spinach, then grate the garlic into the yoghurt with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt.

steps.name: Wilt the spinach
steps.text: Stir in the spinach until it wilts, about 2 minutes.

steps.name: Toast the pine nuts
steps.text: In the small pan, toast the pine nuts in the remaining 1 tbsp oil for 2 minutes until golden, then take it off the heat and stir in the paprika.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Plate the chickpeas and spinach, spoon over the yoghurt, then drizzle with the pine nut oil and dust with sumac. Pierre-Guy: 335g chickpeas and spinach, 120g yoghurt, 9g pine nuts. Mariska: 220g, 80g yoghurt, 6g pine nuts.

portions: Pierre-Guy: 335g chickpeas and spinach + 120g yoghurt + 9g pine nuts
recipes.storage: Refrigerate the chickpeas within 1 hour, and keep the yoghurt and pine nut oil separate. Reheat the chickpeas and spinach in a pan until piping hot, then add the cold yoghurt and the oil.

recipes.name: Spanish potato, egg and Manchego salad
recipes.flag: Egg recipe: adjust breakfast on these days. Time is over 30 min.
ingredients: Dressing: 1½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

steps.name: Kettle and potatoes
steps.text: Put the kettle on, then wash and halve the potatoes.

steps.name: Boil potatoes and eggs
steps.text: Boil the potatoes for 12 minutes, adding the eggs after 3 minutes. While they cook, slice the peppers, shred the gem, dice the Manchego and whisk the dressing.

steps.name: Cool
steps.text: Drain, then cool the potatoes and eggs in cold water for 4 minutes.

steps.name: Peel the eggs
steps.text: Peel and halve the eggs.

steps.name: Box up
steps.text: Divide everything into 4 boxes. Pierre-Guy: 530g with 5 egg halves, 20g dressing and 80g chicken. Mariska: 350g with 3 egg halves and 15g dressing, dressing in its own pot with the gem on top.

recipes.packing: Dressing in its own pot, with the gem on top.

recipes.name: Lemon-mint halloumi with buckwheat and courgette ribbons
ingredients: Dressing: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

steps.name: Kettle and buckwheat
steps.text: Boil the kettle and rinse the buckwheat.

steps.name: Simmer the buckwheat
steps.text: Simmer the buckwheat in the boiled water for 12 minutes. While it cooks, peel the courgettes into ribbons, dice the cucumber, chop the mint and whisk the dressing.

steps.name: Drain and cool
steps.text: Drain the buckwheat, rinse it cold and drain it well.

steps.name: Fry the halloumi
steps.text: Slice the halloumi and fry it in a dry pan for 2 minutes a side.

steps.name: Box up
steps.text: Divide everything into 4 boxes, with the halloumi and seeds on top. Pierre-Guy: 390g, 15g dressing and 80g chicken. Mariska: 255g and 10g dressing in its own pot.

recipes.packing: Dressing in its own pot. The halloumi is good cold.

recipes.name: Greek wild rice salad with feta and pistachios
recipes.timeNote: 20 min calculated + 10 min buffer (18 min Sunday evening, 2 min Monday morning)
ingredients: 1 × 250g pouch wholegrain and wild rice (gluten-free, plain)
Dressing: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

steps.name: Sunday: chop the veg
steps.text: Sunday evening. Dice the cucumber and slice the radishes.

steps.name: Sunday: chop the dill
steps.text: Chop the dill.

steps.name: Sunday: toast seeds and nuts
steps.text: Toast the seeds and pistachios in a dry pan for 3 minutes.

steps.name: Sunday: dressing
steps.text: Whisk the dressing and divide it into 4 pots.

steps.name: Sunday: feta
steps.text: Crumble the feta.

steps.name: Sunday: box up
steps.text: Divide everything into 4 boxes. Pierre-Guy: 285g, 70g dressing and 80g chicken. Mariska: 190g and 45g dressing.

steps.name: Monday: add the rice
steps.text: Monday morning. Open the rice pouch and add half, cold, to Monday's boxes. Refrigerate the rest straight away for Tuesday.

recipes.packing: The yoghurt dressing goes in its own pot.

chicken: 6 portions of 80g. Keep Thursday to Saturday in the fridge, and freeze Sunday to Tuesday's portions, defrosting each one in the fridge the night before. Best in all three salads, especially Salad A with its smoked paprika dressing.
